🔥 mcp-searxng | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide AI assistants with privacy-respecting web search capabilities by connecting them to a SearXNG instance.
✨ Key Features: • Integrates SearXNG API for AI web search • Supports MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, etc.) • Privacy-respecting web search • Search with pagination, filters, direct answers • Read HTML, structured text, and bounded PDF text
📖 Summary: This repository acts as an intermediary server, enabling AI assistants like Claude and Cursor to perform web searches through a SearXNG instance. It translates AI assistant requests into SearXNG queries and returns the results, facilitating privacy-respecting web access for AI.
